title: feat(platform-objects): sys_personal_view, a reader's own named list views, with the owner's delete door (server step)
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RdqjLGpNWRr2BGJHkC5giq)_ Fixes #29443 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none Clause-② measured: on base (`origin/main` @ `a6441636`), `sys_personal_view` does not exist, so every `/api/v1/data/sys_personal_view` call is refused as an unknown object. No registrar mounts `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id` there (read from the source; not driven over HTTP on base). On head both are served, and the dogfood file below is 14/14. No existing answer narrows: the only grants added name the new object, no shipped set loses anything, and the generic data `DELETE` keeps answering what it answered (pinned). Metadata-protocol stays `none`. This is a platform object holding user data, not a key, value or metadata type an author writes, and `/meta` does not serve it (pinned). This closes the server step of #29443: read, create, update, set-as-default, and the owner's own delete. The Console half follows on the card. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：新增平台对象 `sys_personal_view`（个人视图）。一行就是某个用户为某个对象保存的一个命名列表视图，含所有者、对象名、名称、ListView 配置和是否默认。通用数据 API 可以读、建、改和设为默认。另外新增一个所有者删除门 `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`，只能删除调用者自己的视图。 - **为什么改**：依据 #28971 裁决 C，「我的视图」是用户数据，不是视图元数据。这是第一版的服务端一半，以 `sys_user_preference` 为模板。删除门按席位裁决 6583289013 建，沿用 #26161 字母 A 的形状。 - **风险与回滚**：这是纯新增对象和新增路由，已有对象和已有答复都不变。行级范围只到所有者本人；组织管理员的通配绕过对该对象已关闭，他读不到、改不了、也删不了成员的视图（都答 404）。平台管理员（`admin_full_access`）仍然能读成员的视图，这和 `sys_user_preference` 的现状一致，但他删不了（答 403），这一点已列为待决问题。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，表留着无害。 - **先看**：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-personal-view.object.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` 里的两处新条目。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/personal-view-hooks.test.ts src/personal-view-routes.test.ts`，预期 29 个全绿；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/personal-view-row-scope.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 14 个全绿。 - **需要你做的**：删除门的路由名 `/api/v1/personal-views/:id` 由席位在评审中裁定。 ## What changes - **New platform object `sys_personal_view`** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-personal-view.object.ts`). plugin-auth's identity manifest registers it right after `sys_user_preference`, on the same template. - Fields: `user_id` (owner, lookup `sys_user`), `object_name`, `label` (the name the owner gave it), `config` (json, spec's `ListView` shape), `is_default`, and `created_at` / `updated_at`. - It is `managedBy: 'system-data'` and `access: { default: 'private' }`, so a plain `'*'` wildcard grant does not reach it. - It declares the owner-only `defaultRowScope` `user_id == current_user.id` for every operation. - The table carries the organization column, so the Layer 0 wall bounds it too (ADR-0131). The regenerated tenancy census counts it in reach. - **Two write rules** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.ts`). Both registrars register them: `AuthPlugin` on `kernel:ready`, and `IdentityObjectsPlugin.start()` on a kernel without auth. - **The body must be a `ListView`.** A create, and an update that sends `config`, parse `config` with spec's `ListViewSchema`. A body that does not parse is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (an existing code, through `validationFailure`), with one `fields[]` entry per issue, each path under `config`. Text that is not JSON is refused the same way, with the single field `config`. A rename that does not send `config` is not re-judged. - **One default per owner and object.** Saving a row with `is_default: true` clears `is_default` on the owner's other views of the same object, in the same write. It works through the hook's scoped API, so it reaches only rows the writer may write. - **The owner's delete door, `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts`). Seat ruling 6583289013; it takes the shape of #26161's unreact door, ruling 6422861164 letter A. `AuthPlugin` mounts it on the kernel's HTTP server, next to its auth routes. It removes one row, and only the caller's own: 1. The caller is resolved through the one composition, `resolveRequestExecutionContext`. 2. Anonymous is refused `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. 3. A held sign-in gets its policy's `403`. 4. A query parameter is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. 5. The row is read **as the caller**. Another member, an organization administrator, and an unknown id all get `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. 6. A row the caller can read but does not own (`user_id !== caller`; today only a platform administrator reads one) is refused loudly with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and the row stays. 7. Only then is the row removed, as the system, with `attributedUserId` set to the caller and inside the caller's organization. The answer is `200 { id, deleted: true }`. No grant moves: `member_default` is unchanged, and the generic data `DELETE` of the owner's own row is still `403` (pinned). **Route name:** `/api/v1/personal-views/:id` follows the unreact door's convention: a plural resource noun under `/api/v1`, the record id in the path, and no query. It is the seat's call in review. - Its ledger row: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-route-ledger.ts` (`gap`: the Console's My views list is the consumer, and the SDK has no method yet), with `personal-view-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`. - Its `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` declaration (`responses: 0, ok: 0, err: 0`; every body goes through the shared pair). - Its `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs` delegator row. - Its removal is one new elevated write call site in the tenant audit census. `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` regenerated the artefacts (256 sites), and the hand-written figures on `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` follow it (255 → 256, 78 → 79, 145 → 146). - A server that registers no `DELETE` verb (a partial embedding, or a test double) skips the door with a warning that names it, instead of failing the boot. - **Grants** (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`): - `member_default`: read, create and edit on `sys_personal_view`, and **no delete**. The set is bound to the `everyone` anchor, which may not carry a delete bit (ADR-0090 D5). - `organization_admin` (and the derived `organization_admin_no_bypass`): an explicit `sys_personal_view` entry with no `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords`. For this object it overrides the wildcard's super-user bits, the `sys_audit_log` pattern. An organization administrator reads, writes and deletes only their own views. - `admin_full_access` is untouched. Its bare wildcard still **reads** every member's view, exactly as it reads `sys_user_preference` today. Its pins forbid a per-object entry there, and the rescue path depends on it. The door still refuses its delete (`403`). This is listed as an open question on the card. - **The id** is the engine's record id (nanoid). It never contains `.`, so it can never be read as `object.key` view syntax (pinned). - **Not view metadata:** `/meta/view` does not list a personal view, and `/meta/view/` answers 404 (pinned). There is no metadata type, no package export and no metadata write door. - **The only spec touch** (allowed by seat ruling): one line, `'sys_personal_view'` in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']` (`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`). Nothing else under `packages/spec` changes. - **Rosters:** - the CLI organization-ownership inventory row (`fate: 'attribution'`); - the i18n extract config; - the en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES object bundles, regenerated and then translated by hand; - `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json`, regenerated (92 registered / 47 in reach). - **Changeset** `.changeset/29443-personal-views-server.md`: patch for platform-objects, plugin-auth, plugin-security, cli **and spec**. The seat said to include spec only if gates require it. I included it because the spec package publishes a changed constant, and AGENTS.md asks every publishing change to carry a changeset. Drop the spec line if you disagree. Not in scope, and not touched: sharing, team views, admin management, a field picker, packaging, any `ui/**` change, and #29037's `ViewScopeSchema.personal` / `sharing.type`. ## Why #28971 ruling C (comment 6570568131): a reader's named list views are user data, a user-owned platform object modelled on `sys_user_preference`, not a view metadata scope. Seat ruling 6583289013 put the owner's delete in this step. This PR is that server step; the Console half follows on the card. ## Tests - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.test.ts`: 21 tests on real ObjectQL + SQLite `SqlDriver` + `SecurityPlugin`. - **Owner:** saves, lists and renames their own views. The id has no `.`. - **Another member:** `findOne` returns null, `find` returns [], `count` is 0, and an update answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. A create naming another owner is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. - **Admins:** `organization_admin` and `organization_admin_no_bypass` both see none of a member's views (404). An organization admin keeps their own views (control). The recorded boundary: `admin_full_access` reads a member's view. - **Body:** an invalid `config` is refused `VALIDATION_FAILED`, with paths under `config`, on create and on update, and the stored body is unchanged. Also covered: non-JSON text, and a rename without `config`. - **Default:** clearing on insert and on update, with no effect across objects or owners. - **The door's core** (`removeOwnPersonalView`): the owner's row is removed and the owner's other views stay. Another member gets 404 and the row stays. Both organization-admin sets get 404 and the row stays. The platform admin gets 403 and the row stays. An unknown id gets 404. The generic engine delete of the owner's own row is still 403. - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.test.ts`: 8 tests on the door's shell. - It mounts exactly `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`. - An unreadable permission store answers its own 503. Anonymous gets 401. A held sign-in gets its policy's 403. A query parameter gets 400. No engine gets 503. An engine fault gets 500. In none of these is the engine asked. - On success, the removal runs as `{ isSystem, attributedUserId: caller, tenantId: caller's org }`. - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: 3 tests. Every mounted route has a ledger row, and every row is mounted. - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/personal-view-row-scope.dogfood.test.ts`: 14 tests through REST, on the showcase app booted with its default security. - **Owner:** saves views and switches the default. - **Another member:** 404 / 404 / `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and the generic delete answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. A planted row naming another owner gets 403. - **Organization admin** (granted through `sys_user_permission_set`): 404. - **Invalid body:** `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`. - **The predicate guard:** a member whose field-level security hides `showcase_project.budget` can save a view filtering on `budget`, because a save does not re-judge field security. The list query `GET /data/showcase_project?$filter={"budget":{"$gt":0}}` is then refused 403, naming `budget`. - **`/meta/view`** does not serve it. - **The door, `[door]`:** the owner gets 200 and the row is gone. Another member gets 404 and the row stays. An organization admin gets 404 and the row stays. The platform admin reads the row (200) but its delete gets 403, and the row stays. Anonymous gets 401. The generic `DELETE /data/sys_personal_view/` is still 403. - **Forced test edits** (four; each is a list or a capture that the change itself moves): - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-row-scope-declarations.test.ts`: the census of objects declaring `defaultRowScope` gains `DECLARED_AT_BIRTH = { sys_personal_view }`. It is kept separate from the ruling's 23 `DECLARERS`, which are unchanged. A new `it.each` asserts the literal and that no shipped set carries a copy. - `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/bundle-ownership.test.ts`: `OWNED_OBJECTS` now names `sys_personal_view`. That is the guard's own instruction when the extract config gains an object. - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`: the gate's union of ledgers reads `PERSONAL_VIEW_ROUTE_LEDGER`, because the door mounts on the `IHttpServer` port. Without it, "every mounted route is ledgered" was red on the full battery: `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`. The dogfood test task declares the imported source as an input in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`, the same as the storage, i18n and settings ledgers. - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/durability-swallow-repair.test.ts`: the SCIM-stamp case's fake engine kept the *last* `afterInsert` registered, which is now the personal-view default rule. It now selects the stamp by the packageId it registers under (`com.objectstack.plugin-auth`). The assertions are unchanged.
Ablations (each red, then restored, git diff HEAD empty) | Mutation | Red | |---|---| | Remove the `organization_admin` entry for `sys_personal_view` | The `organization_admin` test (404 → row read). `organization_admin_no_bypass` stays green, as expected: that variant strips the bypass bits itself. | | Remove `defaultRowScope` (platform-objects `dist/` rebuilt, preflight confirmed absent) | 4 tests: member read, plant, both organization-admin cases | | Remove the `ListView` check (both hooks) | 3 validation tests | | Force the predicate guard condition false in plugin-security (`dist/` rebuilt) | The dogfood `[predicate]` test (200 instead of 403) | | The door: drop the owner check (`row.user_id !== callerId`) | The platform-admin case (the row was removed) | | The door: read the row as the system instead of the caller | 3 tests: another member and both organization-admin sets (403 instead of 404) | | The door: `AuthPlugin` does not mount it (plugin-auth `dist/` rebuilt, preflight confirmed the marker) | 5 dogfood `[door]` tests. The generic-delete control stays green, as expected. | The `/meta` pin is structural, because no code path serves the object as metadata, so it has no mutation to ablate.
## Verification - Suites on head 805f0481, under `os-verify-lock`: spec `platform-object-names.test.ts` 12/12; platform-objects 109 files, 1507 tests; plugin-auth 215 files, 3687 passed / 10 skipped; plugin-security 241 files, 5201 passed / 45 skipped; cli `organization-ownership-inventory.test.ts` 26/26. Typecheck exit 0 for platform-objects, plugin-auth, plugin-security and cli. - `pnpm lint` (root eslint, `--no-inline-config`) on every changed file: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: OK. - Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` listed 133 commands, all exit 0 on 805f0481, reconciled with `--ran`. - Dogfood battery on 805f0481: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock`, `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 1780s` (shared box), Test Files 398 passed / 3 skipped (401), Tests 3291 passed / 28 skipped (3319), no failures. ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmNjCFNPZLkGxdFdgAq)_
